author: Poag
description: Grants or removes roles based on how long a member has been on the server, with optional required-role gating and an announce channel for role changes. This is a from-scratch reimplementation of fox-v3's timerole cog, and includes a one-time `[p]timedroles migrate` command to import an existing timerole setup (announce channel, reapply/skipbots settings, configured roles, and per-member tracking state) without disruption.
install_msg: Thanks for installing TimedRoles! Get started with `[p]timedroles addrole <role> <time>`. If you're migrating from timerole, run `[p]timedroles migrate` in each server that used it.
short: Grants/removes roles based on time on server.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores, per configured role: a Discord user ID, whether they have already received that role, and when to next check their eligibility for it. This is used only to avoid re-checking members more often than necessary. All stored data for a user is deleted when Red processes a data deletion request for that user.
